name: ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES_ID_TYPE
description: The Auth Entities ID Type table contains information about the ID types (e.g. NPI) of same-line IDs associated with a single entity in the Auth Entities table.

columns.name: AUTH_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the auth bundle record.

columns.name: GROUP_LINE
columns.description: The line number of the associated entity in the auth bundle. Together with AUTH_BUNDLE_ID, this forms the foreign key to the ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES table.

columns.name: VALUE_LINE
columns.description: The line number of one of the multiple entity ID type values associated with the auth bundle and the auth entitty from the ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES table.

columns.name: ENTITY_IDEN_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Auth Entity Identifier Type for the Auth Bundle's entity.
